mapper.select: SELECT t.trip_id AS id, t.member_id, t.title, t.start_date::text AS start_date, t.end_date::text AS end_date, t.people, t.transports, t.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_stop s WHERE s.trip_id = t.trip_id AND s.state <> 'skipped') AS stop_count FROM trip t WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY t.start_date DESC, t.trip_id DESC

SELECT t.trip_id AS id, t.member_id, t.title, t.start_date::text AS start_date, t.end_date::text AS end_date, t.people, t.transports, t.status FROM trip t WHERE t.trip_id = #{tripId} AND t.member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT stop_id AS id, trip_id, day_no AS day, place_id, name, category, address, lat, lng, start_time AS time, stay_min AS stay, fixed, move_mode AS mode, memo, state, to_char(arrived_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS arrived_at, to_char(departed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS departed_at FROM trip_stop WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY day_no, start_time, stop_id
